data.one_liner: A fully customizable round checkbox widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a round checkbox component that supports custom colors, borders, and animations when selected or unselected. It can also be disabled by passing a null callback.
use_when: You need a circular checkbox instead of the standard square Material checkbox
You require custom colors, animations, or child widgets for selected and unselected states
avoid_when: You prefer using the standard built-in Material Checkbox widget
You need a complex form builder integration
strengths: Fully customizable appearance, including colors, borders, and custom widgets
Includes built-in animations for selection changes
Supports disabling the widget automatically when the callback is null
weaknesses: Limited to a single-purpose checkbox UI component
